caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket, centrally positioned on a plain, off-white background. The basket is oval in shape and features a tightly woven, textured body with a combination of light and medium brown hues, suggesting the use of natural fibers. Two handles extend from opposite sides of the basket, each formed by a curved rod that ends in a stylized, carved animal head motif, possibly resembling a bird or serpent. The handles are attached to the basket’s rim, and each is reinforced at the base by a round, flat disc patterned with concentric circles. The overall arrangement is symmetrical, and the objects cast a subtle, pale shadow beneath them. The artist’s name, “William F. Monatis,” is inscribed in brownish-red text in the lower right corner.
title: Doll's Cradle
